pages.title: Western Horse
pages.text: The western horse ($(o)Equus scotti$()) is an extinct horse that lived across the grasslands of North America during the Pleistocene, with its youngest remains dating to around 12,000 years ago.$(br2)It was a true caballine horse, closely related to the modern horse, and is known from several skeletons found together in Texas.$(br2)Horses vanished from the Americas at the end of the Pleistocene and only returned with European colonists.
